correctness.rationale: Schur bounds on explicit V^n kernels imply ||T_d^n|| <= (n!)^-d, so quasinilpotent T_d has norm-convergent Neumann resolvent. The positive integral kernel sums to lambda^-2 E_d(product_j(x_j-t_j)/lambda), E_d(z)=sum_n z^n/(n!)^d, with log E_d(z)=d z^(1/d)+O_d(log(z+2)) by exponential-product upper and Stirling single-term lower bounds. The constant-one input on a small output corner attains operator type d. For nonzero f>=0, product_j(x_j-t_j)≤rho_f wherever integrand nonzero, proving upper rate; choose positive measure patch f>=c with support product >rho_f-eta, and a fixed output corner x>1-delta to prove matching lower rate. Division yields rho_f^(1/d), and cross/diagonal rectangles demonstrate identical marginals with different rho. Scalar E_2 finite diagnostics checked but not needed for infinite positivity proof.
residual_risks: Only λ↓0 along positive real axis and f>=0: cancellation could fail for signed or complex f, and complex-plane spectrum not classified.
